name: drupflare/rom
description: A Drupal 11 database driver for Cloudflare Durable Object SQLite (ctx.storage.sql).

suggest.drupflare/drupflare: Mail, outbound HTTP, images and logging bridged to Workers bindings. Needed by the same deployments that need this driver.

scripts-descriptions.analyze: Runs PHPStan over src/ and tests/ at the level pinned in phpstan.neon.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Runs phpcs with the ruleset in phpcs.xml.dist.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Runs phpcbf over the same ruleset.
scripts-descriptions.test: Runs the driver suite; needs a Drupal 11.2+ root in $DRUPAL_ROOT or argv[1].
